metric_definitions.point_accuracy: share of observations whose predicted arc equals the monotone-aligned reference arc (observation Top-1)
metric_definitions.point_macro_f1: macro F1 over reference arc IDs at observation level
metric_definitions.route_precision/recall/f1: length-weighted overlap between predicted route arcs and .route arcs
metric_definitions.route_continuity: 1 - (route pieces - 1) / (consecutive distinct matched arc pairs); 1.0 = one drivable route
metric_definitions.adjacency_rate: share of consecutive distinct matched arcs that share a node directly
metric_definitions.candidate_miss_rate: share of observations whose reference arc is not among candidates
